name: ostrawind_supply_chain
instructions: Answer supply chain questions with the metrics below instead of writing new formulas. On-time delivery compares a purchase order's received date with its promised date. Fill rate and damage rate are unit-based. Inventory snapshots are month-end point-in-time values: never add on-hand units across snapshot dates; filter to one snapshot date or average them. Forecast accuracy is 1 - WAPE. Contract SLA targets: Pangrove Polymer OTD 92% / fill 98% / damage <=0.5%; Kessling Fastener OTD 95% / fill 99%; Siravan Hydraulics OTD 88% / fill 97%. Carriers have a contracted OTD target per carrier.
examples: Which suppliers missed their on-time delivery SLA last quarter?
What is the fill rate by supplier and month?
Which warehouses had SKUs below safety stock in the latest snapshot?
How accurate was the demand forecast by product category?
Which carrier lanes are below their contracted on-time target?
